subject: I wasn't going to send this sneak peek yet
preview_text: You're getting early access to a feature that changes how you'll use meeting notes forever. This is exclusive.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I was testing something new in the app last night and I almost spilled my coffee. It's that good. And I decided I couldn't wait to tell you.

Most people think note-taking is about capturing what was said. That's the mistake. The real power is in what you do with those notes *after* the meeting ends. That's where the magic happens, and that's what we've been building.

Next month, we're launching 'Smart Connections.' The app will start linking action items from your meeting notes directly to your calendar and task manager. It will see you wrote 'follow up with Sarah' and ask if you want to schedule it. It will find a deadline and block time to work on it. Your notes won't just sit there—they'll become your personal productivity assistant.

Want to be first in line when it drops? The best thing you can do is keep using the app now. The more notes you have, the more powerful this becomes. Open Smart Notes and capture your next meeting. P.S. This is the only place I'm sharing this. You're literally the first to know.
